Unsigned development release. This beta includes 12 settings, 3 profiles, local diagnostics and CSV import. FPS capture, temperatures and Adaptive mode are not yet included. Performance gains are not guaranteed.

A FEW ANSWERS

Keep it simple.

Read the documentation ↗
Will ASTRA always increase my FPS?+

Results depend on your PC, game, drivers and original settings. Interface and privacy preferences mainly improve everyday comfort. ASTRA imports frametimes so you can compare external measurements; no universal performance gain is claimed.

How do I undo a change?+

In Restore, start with the most recent operation. ASTRA restores saved values and types, or removes values that did not exist. Conflicting external changes are reported. Backups remain in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AstraTweaks.

Do I need to install anything?+

Extract the entire archive, then open ASTRA TWEAKS.exe. The app uses Windows PowerShell 5.1, WPF and .NET Framework on compatible Windows installations. The launcher uses a process-scoped execution policy; it does not change any permanent policy. This beta executable is unsigned.

Is my PC compatible?+

The target is Windows 11 and Windows 10 build 19045 or later. Some settings or profiles may be unavailable on specific hardware or managed PCs. Local checks do not replace validation across all versions. Windows 10 editions need their own applicable update coverage.

Does my data leave my PC?+

ASTRA has no account, telemetry or cloud service. Network diagnostics contact only your chosen IP when you start the test. Reports are exported locally and may contain hardware and process names. This website does not set tracking cookies.

Is this beta free?+

Yes. This release is free to download and includes its source code. It is an early development release. Read the guide and limitations before using it.
